findings.title: Missing React key on GrafanaRuleListItem in list map
findings.body: The old `GrafanaRuleLoader` was rendered with `key={key}`. The replacement `GrafanaRuleListItem` in the `case 'grafana'` branch has no key at all. The other branches (`DataSourceRuleLoader`, `UnknownRuleListItem`) still set one. React will warn about missing keys. Because `rules` is appended to as pages load, it will also reconcile items by index, which can mix up the per-item state held in `RuleActionsButtons` (delete modal, silence drawer) between rules.

findings.title: Delete menu item never renders in the ruler-less list view
findings.body: The Delete item is gated on `canDelete && rulerRule`. `GrafanaRuleListItem` now passes only `promRule` and no `rulerRule`, so Delete is never shown in the list view even when the user has permission. `handleDelete` also takes a `RulerRuleDTO`. The new `GrafanaGroupLoader` test confirms this: it grants delete permission yet asserts exactly 4 menu items, with Delete not among them. This is a functional regression for the list view, and the new prom-based `canDelete` ability is effectively dead code.

findings.title: Silence drawer cannot open for prom-only rules
findings.body: The `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` is rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, but `rule` is undefined in the new list view. `AlertRuleMenu` now shows 'Silence notifications' based on `promRule` abilities, and the new test asserts it is present. Clicking it only sets `showSilenceDrawer`, and nothing is rendered, so the menu entry silently does nothing.

findings.title: Pause item hidden for prom-only rules while canPause is still true
findings.body: `MenuItemPauseRule` is rendered only if `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. With no ruler rule in the list view, pause is never shown even though `canPause` is true from the prom abilities. `canPause` still feeds `showDivider`, so the menu can end up with a divider that is not justified by any visible item.

findings.title: Federated rule group check dropped for all callers
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` used to call `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` to mark federated Mimir groups as immutable. The refactor delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false` (with only a TODO). Federated data-source rule groups can now show edit, delete and pause as supported in every existing view that uses the deprecated hook, which is a behavioural regression.

findings.title: returnTo parameter dropped from the rule view link
findings.body: The previous implementation built the href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo: createReturnTo() })`. The new one builds `/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view` with no `returnTo`. The rule details page therefore loses its 'back to list with the current filters' navigation when opened from the list.

findings.title: Tests for removed behaviour deleted without replacement; no Delete/Silence coverage
findings.body: The tests for the creating and deleting operation states and for `matchRules` were removed together with the feature, which is fine. The new tests, though, only check that the menu contains 4 items. They do not exercise Delete, Silence or Pause from the list view, which is why the dead-end behaviour in `AlertRuleMenu` and `RuleActionsButtons` goes unnoticed.
